title: Classify complete-suite failures against an exact inherited exclusion set
failure_signature: The first 1,161-test discovery found two known v646-v1 commit-cap failures and one unexpected v646-v6 x1 live-tree lifecycle failure, while its bounded tail did not enumerate every failure header.
candidate_workaround: Parse every FAIL and ERROR header, reserve only the two exact inherited v646-v1 commit-cap methods, bind the v646-v6 x1 absence check to its x1 Git object, and fail on any other event.
recurrence_guard: A raw nonzero suite may earn eligible credit only when every event is named and belongs to the frozen exact exclusion set; exclusions cannot grow implicitly.
rollback: Retain the raw three-failure run, award no full-suite credit, and change only the unexpected lifecycle assertion plus diagnostic classification.
scope_boundary: Owner-local repository testing only; same-infrastructure validation is not independent reproduction, production certification, or exhaustive security assurance.
